body.title: bug: Issues with comment history menu for code comments
body.body:
### Can you reproduce the bug on the Forgejo test instance?

Yes, I've linked the repository below

### Description

1. Having a review with multiple code comments (`CommentTypeCode`) and also a general review feedback​/comment (`CommentTypeReview`), if you edit the general review comment the '• edited' comment history menu is wrongly also added to all of the child code comments.

For this I've already proposed a fix in !15019 (where you can find more details and a screenshot).

---

2. The right margin of avatars shown in the comment history menu from code comments is missing (there is no space between the avatar and the user name):

![2026-10-25 missing right margin](/attachments/de15109d-a524-48a3-b22c-00e7ebd7899f)

This seems to be a regression of !8138 caused by [this CSS rule](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/src/commit/cd08265406cc9e38b384b256aecdc463d4269664/web_src/css/repo.css#L1013-L1015). @0ko already [suggested a fix](https://matrix.to/#/!cPyfRdDQ8A_9Nrr3E_Hk_aOXlFoC_L7nE1XE62gH4gI/$nJtXRWNi9vqokNx9JFTqNu1Gby9a-652Vok6L2WUi9U) in the _Forgejo UI_ room.

---

3. After the user who posted and edited a code comment is deleted, the username (i.e. Ghost) is missing from the comment history menu items:

![2026-10-25 missing username ('Ghost') on the right of avatar](/attachments/c55348a9-d182-4cb8-bff7-de684092aee8)

Without checking this assumption, I think it might happen for all types of comments, because `FetchIssueContentHistoryList()` [returns null for `user_name` and `user_full_name`](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/src/commit/a387636b9a9e1c92388d567508f67b2d56a3ba4e/models/issues/content_history.go#L152) in case of deleted users.

Instead of changing the SQL query from `FetchIssueContentHistoryList()` we could [check for empty strings](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/src/commit/a387636b9a9e1c92388d567508f67b2d56a3ba4e/routers/web/repo/issue_content_history.go#L74-L77) in `GetContentHistoryList()` and use the `GhostUserName` constant when username is missing.

---

4. When a new comment is posted in a review conversation (as a reply to a code comment), if one of the previous comments in the thread was edited and the '• edited' comment history menu is visible, when the new comment is saved the history menu will be removed (from the edited comment). Screenshots are from local development environment, but reproduced also while playing on [v18.next.forgejo.org](https://v18.next.forgejo.org/floss4good/projx/pulls/1).

| before reply - edited menu visible | reply posted - edited menu removed |
| :---:|:---:|
| ![2026-10-25 reply pending - edited menu visible](/attachments/502d6298-28c2-4db3-ac46-0a9f7043ccf6) | ![2026-10-25 reply posted - edited menu removed](/attachments/259975ed-94b5-430a-85aa-d28e8f610ce3) |

### Screenshots

_Included in Description._

### Forgejo Version

55849de717c317b217ae10f0c61e96db1d47e184 / Codeberg / v18.next.forgejo.org

### Browser Version

Firefox 158.0 (64-bit)

body.title: bug: 500/nil deref on duplicate reaction post
body.body:
### Can you reproduce the bug on the Forgejo test instance?

No, I can't try it on the test instance for some reason

### Description

`POST /api/v1/repos/$ORG/$REPO/issues/comments/$ID/reactions` to add a reaction that's already there 500s with `panic in 7.3ms @ repo/issue_reaction.go:83(repo.PostIssueCommentReaction), err=runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference` + `PANIC: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference` with stacktrace
```
...
forgejo/routers/api/v1/repo/issue_reaction.go:186 (0x2e31e14)
forgejo/routers/api/v1/repo/issue_reaction.go:124 (0x2e31bde)
...
```

Claude says

models/issues.CreateReaction returns the existing reaction together with
ErrReactionAlreadyExist. Since a48683f064 (“feat: add internal APIs for
reactions notifications”, #13017) services/issue.CreateIssueReaction and
CreateCommentReaction do if err != nil { return nil, err }, discarding that
reaction. The API handler’s already-exists branch in
routers/api/v1/repo/issue_reaction.go (lines 185 and 396) still reads
reaction.Type and reaction.CreatedUnix and dereferences nil.

### Forgejo Version

v17

### How are you running Forgejo?

self-hosted

### Logs

_No response_

### Database

PostgreSQL
